title: Without a hard pair, counting is polynomial with bounded homology
claim: Let G = N x| C_r with p not dividing r, N a finite p-group that is a central extension of an elementary abelian group B by a C_r-invariant elementary abelian A by an equivariant bilinear cocycle, and kappa the commutator pairing. Call (chi, chi') a hard pair if chi, chi' and chi chi' are nontrivial characters of C_r and kappa is nonzero from the chi- and chi'-eigencomponents of B to the chi chi'-component of A. If G has no hard pair, then for fixed G and a bound on |H1|, |Hom(pi1 M, G)| is computable in polynomial time for closed orientable 3-manifolds (the proof uses only bounded dim H^1(M; F_p), boundedly many maps to C_r and bounded H^2(M; A_1), so it also covers knot groups): enumerate the bounded trivial-character part, after which the nontrivial A-components of the obstruction are affine and the trivial one is a bounded number of quadratic conditions counted by Gauss sums. For Heisenberg groups with h acting by (a x, b y, a b z) this is the case a = 1, b = 1 or ab = 1.
failure_conditions: A manifold and character on which the polynomial route disagrees with direct enumeration.
A total count that disagrees with brute-force enumeration.
A hard pattern accepted by the polynomial route (the control must fail).
foundation_claim_scope: Groups satisfying the hypotheses (central extensions of elementary abelian groups with an equivariant bilinear cocycle, coprime cyclic action); bounded |H1| (or bounded dim H^1(M; F_p), boundedly many maps to C_r and bounded H^2(M; A_1), as for knot groups). Cited, not proved: Samperton-Weiss Lemma 3.1.2 (quadratic Gauss sums), Matei-Suciu (twisted lifting), the injection H^2(pi) -> H^2 of the presentation complex. Checked on Heisenberg groups with small knots and p-torsion. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: the polynomial route against direct enumeration on 56 manifold-character cases without a hard pair (r- and rp-surgeries, p-torsion present), totals against brute force in eight cases, and a failing control on a hard pattern; no human or external review
